compute_jacobian_jacrev: compute the Jacobian of a function with respect to a specified argument using jacrev from functorch
compute_jacobian_jacfwd: compute the Jacobian of a function with respect to a specified argument using jacfwd from functorch
compute_hessian: compute the Hessian of a function by composing jacrev with jacrev from functorch
compute_batch_jacobian: compute batched Jacobians by composing vmap with jacrev over a batch of inputs
compute_batch_hessian: compute batched Hessians by composing vmap with hessian over a batch of inputs
